keyPoints.descZh: 答出 No, it didn’t（过去不是热门景点）

q1.rubricZh: 要点：回答“No, it didn’t.”（它过去不是热门景点）。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段说它在专业自然摄影师中小有名气，但当地人通常不把它当旅游景点，所以过去不热门。问句是否定形式，答“No, it didn’t.”表示“确实不热门”。

evidence.quote: locals don’t usually think of it as a tourist destination

q2.sampleAnswer: Because of its colourful windows. / Because it has colourful windows.

keyPoints.descZh: 因为它有五颜六色的窗户

q2.rubricZh: 要点：因为它的窗户五颜六色。
q2.explanationZh: 第四段直接说，人们叫它“彩虹警察局”是因为它的窗户色彩缤纷。

evidence.quote: People call it the “Rainbow Police Station” because of its colourful windows.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because Xiaohongshu recommended tourist attractions to them and told them where to check in. That’s just what many tour guides usually do.

keyPoints.descZh: 小红书给她们推荐了旅游景点
examples: Xiaohongshu recommended tourist attractions to them

keyPoints.descZh: 小红书告诉她们去哪里打卡
examples: told them where to check in

q3.rubricZh: 要点：小红书向她们推荐景点；告诉她们去哪里打卡（做的正是导游常做的事）。
q3.explanationZh: 刘小姐是靠小红书的推荐发现了这个地方，还把它叫做自己的导游；艾米的妈妈说有了小红书就不需要导游，因为知道该去哪打卡。两人都觉得小红书做了导游的工作：推荐景点、指路打卡。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I’d like to. Because when I’m travelling, I just want to take some pictures at the most popular tourist attractions. Xiaohongshu can now help me discover these destinations. There is no need to spend lots of money to hire a tour guide. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 明确表明态度（愿意 / 不愿意）
给出至少一条合理理由
examples: Xiaohongshu can help me discover popular destinations.

q4.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：先表明态度（Yes/No），再给出至少一条合理理由。
q4.explanationZh: 这是观点题，没有唯一答案。先说愿意或不愿意，再说一个理由，比如能发现热门景点、不用花钱请导游；或者担心景点和宣传不一样、人太多。

evidence.quote: Xiaohongshu has turned some lesser-known places into must-see attractions.
